meta.title: veyq - Structured Memories
meta.description: veyq is a self-hostable platform for structured Memories with photos, videos, journal text, maps, tracks and context.

hero.title: Memories that mean more.
hero.lead: veyq is the self-hostable platform for structured memories. For trips, special moments and the people you share them with.

concept.title: More than photos. Your whole story.
concept.body: veyq organizes memories as Memories. Each Memory can hold photos, videos, maps, tracks, playlists, journal text and context.

structured.title: Structured
structured.body: Nested Memories give trips, events and moments a natural shape.

journal.title: Journal
journal.body: Write your story in Markdown and connect it with media and context.

context.title: Context
context.body: Maps, GPS tracks, weather and playlists make memories feel alive.

shared.title: Shared
shared.body: Share Memories and collect contributions without turning veyq into a social network.

screens.title: One surface for the whole memory.
screens.body: Real product screenshots can be dropped into these slots later.

desktop.title: Memory overview
desktop.body: Desktop view with gallery, journal, map, tracks and a context panel.

mobile.title: Ready on mobile
mobile.body: A compact Memory view for every trip.

map.title: Journey context
map.body: Maps and tracks show where moments happened.

selfhosted.title: Your data. Your home.
selfhosted.body: veyq runs on your own server. Your Memories belong to you, not to a cloud.

final.title: Open source, built for Memories.
final.body: veyq is early, but the direction is clear: curate memories, self-host them and share them beautifully.
